hits.title: Sapiom Raises $35 Million Series A to Power the Next Trillion AI Agents | Morningstar
hits.snippet: Sapiom, the platform builders use to ship, run, and scale AI agents, today announced a $35 million Series A. The round was led by Dragonfly, with participation from Accel, Gradient, Coinbase Ventures, Operator Collective, Formus Capital, and VanEck Ventures, alongside continued support from existing investors including Okta Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Anthropic, and Array Ventures. The Series A comes six months after Sapiom's $15 million seed round and just 11 months after the company was founded, bringing total funding to $50 million. ... Founded in San Francisco in 2025 by Ilan Zerbib, Sapiom has raised $50 million from investors including Dragonfly, Accel, Gradient, Coinbase Ventures, Okta Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Anthropic, Array Ventures, Operator Collective, Formus Capital and VanEck Ventures.

hits.title: Startup Sapiom routes clients’ AI to lowest-cost tokens  | Semafor
hits.snippet: Sapiom is betting it can lower those token costs, and is raising a $35 million series A led by venture-fund Dragonfly’s Haseeb Qureshi. The company raised $15 million earlier this year in a seed round led by Accel. The company is also launching a new, single API key — a model router that automatically sends requests to the most efficient AI model for the job. The product puts it squarely in competition with OpenRouter, the biggest name in that field.
